#1
मय्यासक्तमनाः|mayi āsakta-manāḥ|aham — I (mayi: loc. sg. 'in me');;āsakta — clung, attached (past participle of ā-sañj, first compound member);;manas — mind (āsakta-manas: 'mind attached [to me]', nom. sg. masc.; mayi + ā- → mayyā-)
पार्थ|pārtha|Pārtha — 'son of Pṛthā' (i.e. Kuntī), Arjuna (vocative)
योगं|yogam|yoga — yoga, kept untranslated (acc. sg.)
युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः|yuñjan mad-āśrayaḥ|yuj — to yoke, discipline (oneself) (yuñjan: present participle 'practicing, disciplining', nom. sg.);;mad — me (stem form mad- in compound);;āśraya — refuge, reliance (mad-āśraya: 'having me as refuge', nom. sg.)
--
असंशयं|asaṃśayam|a-saṃśaya — without doubt, undoubtedly (adverbial acc. sg. neut.)

मां|mām|aham — I (mām: acc. sg. 'me')
यथा|yathā|yathā — how, in what way (adverb)

#2

--
